items.html: And the essence of MaH is in the male, and its illumination in the female; and the reverse in BaN. And since Hochma and Bina are from Bina of MaH alone, their root is judgments and not mercy, even though they are MaH. And it is possible that MaH is in the Hochma of Aba and in the Hochma of Ima, and BaN is in the Bina of Aba and in the Bina of Ima, and so it will be in ZA.
